241     async def reply(  # pylint: disable=too-many-branches
242         self,
243         msg: Msg | list[Msg] | None = None,
244         structured_model: Type[BaseModel] | None = None,
245     ) -> Msg:
246         """Generate a reply based on the current state and input arguments.
247 
248         Args:
249             msg (`Msg | list[Msg] | None`, optional):
250                 The input message(s) to the agent.
251             structured_model (`Type[BaseModel] | None`, optional):
252                 The required structured output model. If provided, the agent
253                 is expected to generate structured output in the `metadata`
254                 field of the output message.
255 
256         Returns:
257             `Msg`:
258                 The output message generated by the agent.
259         """
260         # Record the input message(s) in the memory
261         await self.memory.add(msg)
262 
263         # -------------- Retrieval process --------------
264         # Retrieve relevant records from the long-term memory if activated
265         await self._retrieve_from_long_term_memory(msg)
266         # Retrieve relevant documents from the knowledge base(s) if any
267         await self._retrieve_from_knowledge(msg)
268 
269         # Control if LLM generates tool calls in each reasoning step
270         tool_choice: Literal["auto", "none", "any", "required"] | None = None
271 
272         # -------------- Structured output management --------------
273         self._required_structured_model = structured_model
274         # Record structured output model if provided
275         if structured_model:
276             # Register generate_response tool only when structured output
277             # is required
278             if self.finish_function_name not in self.toolkit.tools:
279                 self.toolkit.register_tool_function(
280                     getattr(self, self.finish_function_name),
281                 )
282 
283             # Set the structured output model
284             self.toolkit.set_extended_model(
285                 self.finish_function_name,
286                 structured_model,
287             )
288             tool_choice = "required"
289         else:
290             # Remove generate_response tool if no structured output is required
291             self.toolkit.remove_tool_function(self.finish_function_name)
292 
293         # -------------- The reasoning-acting loop --------------
294         # Cache the structured output generated in the finish function call
295         structured_output = None
296         for _ in range(self.max_iters):
297             # -------------- The reasoning process --------------
298             msg_reasoning = await self._reasoning(tool_choice)
299 
300             # -------------- The acting process --------------
301             futures = [
302                 self._acting(tool_call)
303                 for tool_call in msg_reasoning.get_content_blocks(
304                     "tool_use",
305                 )
306             ]
307             # Parallel tool calls or not
308             if self.parallel_tool_calls:
309                 structured_outputs = await asyncio.gather(*futures)
310             else:
311                 # Sequential tool calls
312                 structured_outputs = [await _ for _ in futures]
313 
314             # -------------- Check for exit condition --------------
315             # If structured output is still not satisfied
316             if self._required_structured_model:
317                 # Remove None results
318                 structured_outputs = [_ for _ in structured_outputs if _]
319 
320                 msg_hint = None
321                 # If the acting step generates structured outputs
322                 if structured_outputs:
323                     # Cache the structured output data
324                     structured_output = structured_outputs[-1]
325 
326                     # Prepare textual response
327                     if msg_reasoning.has_content_blocks("text"):
328                         # Re-use the existing text response if any to avoid
329                         # duplicate text generation
330                         return Msg(
331                             self.name,
332                             msg_reasoning.get_content_blocks("text"),
333                             "assistant",
334                             metadata=structured_output,
335                         )
336 
337                     # Generate a textual response in the next iteration
338                     msg_hint = Msg(
339                         "user",
340                         "<system-hint>Now generate a text "
341                         "response based on your current situation"
342                         "</system-hint>",
343                         "user",
344                     )
345                     await self._reasoning_hint_msgs.add(msg_hint)
346 
347                     # Just generate text response in the next reasoning step
348                     tool_choice = "none"
349                     # The structured output is generated successfully
350                     self._required_structured_model = None
351 
352                 elif not msg_reasoning.has_content_blocks("tool_use"):
353                     # If structured output is required but no tool call is
354                     # made, remind the llm to go on the task
355                     msg_hint = Msg(
356                         "user",
357                         "<system-hint>Structured output is "
358                         f"required, go on to finish your task or call "
359                         f"'{self.finish_function_name}' to generate the "

361                         "user",

365                     tool_choice = "required"
366

373                 msg_reasoning.metadata = structured_output

379

381         if self._static_control:

393     async def _reasoning(
394         self,
395         tool_choice: Literal["auto", "none", "any", "required"] | None = None,
396     ) -> Msg:
397         """Perform the reasoning process."""
398         if self.plan_notebook:
399             # Insert the reasoning hint from the plan notebook
400             hint_msg = await self.plan_notebook.get_current_hint()
401             if self.print_hint_msg and hint_msg:
402                 await self.print(hint_msg)
403             await self._reasoning_hint_msgs.add(hint_msg)
404 
405         # Convert Msg objects into the required format of the model API
406         prompt = await self.formatter.format(
407             msgs=[
408                 Msg("system", self.sys_prompt, "system"),
409                 *await self.memory.get_memory(),
410                 # The hint messages to guide the agent's behavior, maybe empty
411                 *await self._reasoning_hint_msgs.get_memory(),
412             ],
413         )
414         # Clear the hint messages after use
415         await self._reasoning_hint_msgs.clear()
416 
417         res = await self.model(
418             prompt,
419             tools=self.toolkit.get_json_schemas(),
420             tool_choice=tool_choice,
421         )
422 
423         # handle output from the model
424         interrupted_by_user = False
425         msg = None
426         try:
427             if self.model.stream:
428                 msg = Msg(self.name, [], "assistant")
429                 async for content_chunk in res:
430                     msg.content = content_chunk.content
431                     await self.print(msg, False)
432                 await self.print(msg, True)
433 
434                 # Add a tiny sleep to yield the last message object in the
435                 # message queue
436                 await asyncio.sleep(0.001)
437 
438             else:
439                 msg = Msg(self.name, list(res.content), "assistant")
440                 await self.print(msg, True)
441 
442         except asyncio.CancelledError as e:
443             interrupted_by_user = True
444             raise e from None
445 
446         finally:
447             # None will be ignored by the memory
448             await self.memory.add(msg)
449 
450             # Post-process for user interruption
451             if interrupted_by_user and msg:
452                 # Fake tool results
453                 tool_use_blocks: list = msg.get_content_blocks(
454                     "tool_use",
455                 )
456                 for tool_call in tool_use_blocks:
457                     msg_res = Msg(
458                         "system",
459                         [
460                             ToolResultBlock(
461                                 type="tool_result",
462                                 id=tool_call["id"],
463                                 name=tool_call["name"],
464                                 output="The tool call has been interrupted "
465                                 "by the user.",
466                             ),
467                         ],
468                         "system",
469                     )
470                     await self.memory.add(msg_res)
471                     await self.print(msg_res, True)
472         return msg

474     async def _acting(self, tool_call: ToolUseBlock) -> dict | None:
475         """Perform the acting process, and return the structured output if
476         it's generated and verified in the finish function call.
477 
478         Args:
479             tool_call (`ToolUseBlock`):
480                 The tool use block to be executed.
481 
482         Returns:
483             `Union[dict, None]`:
484                 Return the structured output if it's verified in the finish
485                 function call, otherwise return None.
486         """
487 
488         tool_res_msg = Msg(
489             "system",
490             [
491                 ToolResultBlock(
492                     type="tool_result",
493                     id=tool_call["id"],
494                     name=tool_call["name"],
495                     output=[],
496                 ),
497             ],
498             "system",
499         )
500         try:
501             # Execute the tool call
502             tool_res = await self.toolkit.call_tool_function(tool_call)
503 
504             # Async generator handling
505             async for chunk in tool_res:
506                 # Turn into a tool result block
507                 tool_res_msg.content[0][  # type: ignore[index]
508                     "output"
509                 ] = chunk.content
510 
511                 await self.print(tool_res_msg, chunk.is_last)
512 
513                 # Raise the CancelledError to handle the interruption in the
514                 # handle_interrupt function
515                 if chunk.is_interrupted:
516                     raise asyncio.CancelledError()
517 
518                 # Return message if generate_response is called successfully
519                 if (
520                     tool_call["name"] == self.finish_function_name
521                     and chunk.metadata
522                     and chunk.metadata.get("success", False)
523                 ):
524                     # Only return the structured output
525                     return chunk.metadata.get("structured_output")
526 
527             return None
528 
529         finally:
530             # Record the tool result message in the memory
531             await self.memory.add(tool_res_msg)

687     async def _retrieve_from_knowledge(
688         self,
689         msg: Msg | list[Msg] | None,
690     ) -> None:
691         """Insert the retrieved documents from the RAG knowledge base(s) if
692         available.
693 
694         Args:
695             msg (`Msg | list[Msg] | None`):
696                 The input message to the agent.
697         """
698         if self.knowledge and msg:
699             # Prepare the user input query
700             query = None
701             if isinstance(msg, Msg):
702                 query = msg.get_text_content()
703             elif isinstance(msg, list):
704                 query = "\n".join(_.get_text_content() for _ in msg)
705 
706             # Skip if the query is empty
707             if not query:
708                 return
709 
710             # Rewrite the query by the LLM if enabled
711             if self.enable_rewrite_query:
712                 try:
713                     rewrite_prompt = await self.formatter.format(
714                         msgs=[
715                             Msg("system", self.sys_prompt, "system"),
716                             *await self.memory.get_memory(),
717                             Msg(
718                                 "user",
719                                 "<system-hint>Now you need to rewrite "
720                                 "the above user query to be more specific and "
721                                 "concise for knowledge retrieval. For "
722                                 "example, rewrite the query 'what happened "
723                                 "last day' to 'what happened on 2023-10-01' "
724                                 "(assuming today is 2023-10-02)."
725                                 "</system-hint>",
726                                 "user",
727                             ),
728                         ],
729                     )
730                     stream_tmp = self.model.stream
731                     self.model.stream = False
732                     res = await self.model(
733                         rewrite_prompt,
734                         structured_model=_QueryRewriteModel,
735                     )
736                     self.model.stream = stream_tmp
737                     if res.metadata and res.metadata.get("rewritten_query"):
738                         query = res.metadata["rewritten_query"]
739 
740                 except Exception as e:
741                     logger.warning(
742                         "Skipping the query rewriting due to error: %s",
743                         str(e),
744                     )
745 
746             docs: list[Document] = []
747             for kb in self.knowledge:
748                 # retrieve the user input query
749                 docs.extend(
750                     await kb.retrieve(query=query),
751                 )
752             if docs:
753                 # Rerank by the relevance score
754                 docs = sorted(
755                     docs,
756                     key=lambda doc: doc.score or 0.0,
757                     reverse=True,
758                 )
759                 # Prepare the retrieved knowledge string
760                 retrieved_msg = Msg(
761                     name="user",
762                     content=[
763                         TextBlock(
764                             type="text",
765                             text=(
766                                 "<retrieved_knowledge>Use the following "
767                                 "content from the knowledge base(s) if it's "
768                                 "helpful:\n"
769                             ),
770                         ),
771                         *[_.metadata.content for _ in docs],
772                         TextBlock(
773                             type="text",
774                             text="</retrieved_knowledge>",
775                         ),
776                     ],
777                     role="user",
778                 )
779                 if self.print_hint_msg:
780                     await self.print(retrieved_msg, True)
781                 await self.memory.add(retrieved_msg)
